description: Present the 25-minute timer, Start/Pause/Reset controls, and daily session counter in a clean, high-contrast, single-style layout that students can use immediately without setup or distraction

props.text: Present the 25-minute timer, Start/Pause/Reset controls, and daily session counter in a clean, high-contrast, single-style layout that students can use immediately without setup or distraction
Large, high-contrast countdown display showing MM:SS format (e.g., 25:00), using clear, readable typography with sufficient size for easy reading at a glance
Primary action button to begin the 25-minute countdown, visible when timer is at initial state or reset
Primary action button to pause the running countdown, visible only when timer is actively running
Secondary action button to return timer to 25:00, available when timer has been started
Display showing number of completed 25-minute sessions today (e.g., '3 sessions today'), updates when timer reaches 0:00
Confirmation message displayed when timer reaches 0:00, appears alongside or replaces timer temporarily
